title: add-rollback-guard-backup-restore-version-pinning-private-installer
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: private deployments require safe, reversible upgrades. This PR adds an opinionated rollback guard that ties together version pinning, transactional schema migrations, and automated backup/restore hooks for the private-installer flow. The goal is to make upgrades to on-prem/VPC customers safe and auditable and to reduce the risk of unrecoverable migration failures.

What this change does: 
- Adds a rollback-guard controller that validates upgrade plans against a policy (version pinning + migration compatibility matrix).
- Introduces pre-upgrade backup hooks (Postgres pg_dump + object-store snapshot) and post-upgrade verification steps.
- Adds transactional schema migration runner that fails fast and marks upgrades as resumable/rollback-able when possible.
- Helm chart updates: new hooks, new values (versionPin, backupPolicy, migrationStrategy).
- Terraform module changes: exposes backup bucket and KMS key id inputs and adds lifecycle timeouts for upgrades.
- Installer CLI updates: new `redwood-installer plan-upgrade` and `redwood-installer rollback` commands with dry-run and confirm flags.
- Integration test harness: cluster-level e2e which simulates upgrade, migration failure, and rollback.

Checklist: 
- [x] Backup hooks implemented and tested locally (pg_dump + s3 compatible snapshot)
- [x] Transactional migrations runner + migration metadata table
- [x] Helm chart values and hooks wired into installer
- [x] Terraform inputs + example usage added
- [x] CLI commands + help text
- [x] E2E test that simulates a broken migration and verifies successful rollback
- [x] Docs: upgrade and rollback runbook updated

Risks and scope: 
- This lands new cluster-level operations; cluster operators must enable the backupPolicy and provide a reachable object-store and KMS key. Default behavior is off (safe).
- We do not change existing hosted deployments. This only affects private-installer and Helm/Terraform manifests for private deployment.

Related: ENG-4321 (upgrade safety epic), ENG-5498 (installer CLI improvements), SUP-1204 (customer incident that motivated transactional migrations).

E2E CI (2025-02-18): First e2e run failed - intermittent race in controller startup on CI. Author: introduced readiness gating for hooks and added small startup delay; reran tests.

release_notes: Adds rollback guard, pre-upgrade backup hooks, transactional schema migrations, and installer CLI commands for safer private deployments. Defaults are opt-in; operators must enable backupPolicy and configure object store + KMS.
